retiredElder.selfAttendance: QR and direct check-in in authorized campuses; existing windows, suspension and deduplication rules
retiredElder.volunteerCredit: valid attendance only under existing counting rules; identity alone never grants automatic leader credit

maintenanceAffairs.tokenReplacement: same event and same issuer only
maintenanceAffairs.attendanceSource: checkinSource: kind, tokenId, issuerMemberId, issuerName; correction uses operatorMemberId and operatorAccount
maintenanceAffairs.sourceVisibility: scoped attendance management only; absent on self-service records and workbench
maintenanceAffairs.automaticOfficeCandidates: ordinary members with active maintenance_affairs appointments and whole-shift availability on the selected day and campus; at most one per day, allow empty days with nonblocking gaps; deputy heads and higher positions are exempt; exchange alone does not qualify for automatic repair duty

dutyWorkflow.weekConvention: dutyWeekKey is Monday through Sunday for rosters, reminders, personal duty and weekly attendance export; existing Sunday booking calendars and service-day configuration keep their own convention; exact dates and historic Monday keys are unchanged
dutyWorkflow.manualPeople: repair: hardware members, exchange, other members; office: primary office/art/publicity members, other departments; expose homeCampusId, authorized campuses and memberships with real department/position labels; cross-department or availability mismatch remains a manual exception
dutyWorkflow.participants: availability submission and automatic suggestions only for active primary hardware members or maintenance_affairs members; all other members see a nonparticipation panel; any active deputy-head-or-higher appointment excludes availability submission, new roster assignments and cover acceptance
dutyWorkflow.availability: one shared set of usual windows and weekly exceptions without dutyType; latest legacy row per period is reused with revision protection; empty exception means unavailable, null restores usual; no new tables or migration
dutyWorkflow.availabilityMinimum: saving requires at least one Monday-through-Thursday whole shift in an authorized campus; restoring usual requires a nonempty valid usual record; legacy empty records remain readable
dutyWorkflow.checkInConfirmation: POST /api/attendance/preview accepts token or direct campusId and returns identity, event details and availabilityReminder for next week; reminder is nonblocking and contains no form; all staff entry points share one confirmation with no success dialog
dutyWorkflow.shift: 19:00–21:00 Asia/Shanghai; unchanged legacy special shifts retain their times and IDs

assignments? (published and manual items to retain)
suggestions.uniqueness: assign each eligible hardware member exactly one weekly shift across duty types in their campus; assign office-only candidates at most once and count retained shifts toward the weekly limit
suggestions.optimization: joint min-cost matching with repair daily spread at most two and at most one automatic office assignment on each uncovered available day; preserve retained shifts and return 409 if no feasible plan exists
suggestions.priority: maximize office days covered, then minimize conflicts; prefer using dual-qualified candidates in the office when both primary objectives are tied
suggestions.review: gaps carry businessDate and dutyType independently; unassigned carry dutyType, reasonCode and reason; recomputed for manual drafts and publishing so missing repair candidates remain visible

campusWeek.manualExceptions: ordinary member repeat shifts, availability and department mismatches are warned and audited; leadership assignments and time overlaps are rejected; no leader coverage requirement

dutyWorkflow.cover: self-service: the scheduled member invites a replacement, the recipient accepts or declines and the sender may cancel; initiation and acceptance require the Shanghai current date to be earlier than every involved duty date, expiring at midnight of the earliest date; expired pending invitations are displayed as expired and excluded from pending counts without new storage; acceptance atomically updates the existing published roster without manager approval or republishing, preserving shift ID and publication timestamp while advancing assignment and roster revisions; scope, member eligibility and overlap guards remain enforced
dutyWorkflow.leaveRemoval: 0056 drops roster_leaves and removes leave-specific audit and receipt rows; leave endpoints, services and status fields are removed; no replacement leave storage; leave requests are handled offline

day.counts: scope first, unique scheduled members; temporary arrivals separate

review.status: retired: returns 410; service and repository writes removed; historical records preserved but never read for current calculations; missing attendance after final scheduled shift ends is automatically absent, corrections clear absence

correction.defaultTime: server resolves the earliest assigned shift start in the selected campus and day; otherwise 19:00 Asia/Shanghai; never accepts a supplied occurredAt, recordId or eventId in duty_start mode
correction.recordTime: UI accepts time of day only; date is fixed to the original duty businessDate; server rejects cross-date duty corrections
